title: Arshela: The Political Throne Heir
description: You are Arshela, the Prime Minister's daughter. Having lived surrounded by power, it is now time for you to prove yourself amidst accusations of a political dynasty.

chapter1.title: Career Start
chapter1.description: School days are over. Your family suggests you enter politics. However, the shadow of your father's great name is a double-edged sword.
chapter1.dilemma: How should Arshela start her career?

A.feedback: You took the fast track. Effective, but the public scoffs at your nepotism.

B.feedback: A quiet and expensive path. People are starting to notice, but the risk is high.

chapter2_A.title: Proving Herself: The Fast Track
chapter2_A.description: The public doubts your competence. The 'Daddy's Girl' label sticks hard. You must quickly prove yourself before losing momentum.

A.description: Ask for Easy Tasks from Father's Connections
A.feedback: The task was completed easily. Your image improved, but it's just a gimmick.

B.feedback: A slow process. You are tired of studying, but your foundation strengthens.

chapter2_B.title: Proving Herself: The Independent Route
chapter2_B.description: The independent path turns out to be brutal. Without your father's help, you are attacked left and right. You must prove your worth.

A.description: Give Up, Ask for Father's Connections' Help
A.feedback: You finally compromised. Idealism fades for survival.

B.description: Stay on the Independent & Competence Path
B.feedback: You successfully obtained an independent project. The public starts to respect you.

chapter3_A.title: Consultant Dilemma
chapter3_A.description: You are often invited to be a consultant. There is a huge offer from a demanding company, but you still have a running contract with another company. The rules forbid holding multiple positions.
chapter3_A.dilemma: Accept the dual offer or stay loyal to the contract?

A.feedback: You lost a lot of money, but you sleep soundly with integrity.

B.feedback: Your wallet is instantly thick. But this conflict of interest is a time bomb.

chapter3_B.title: Consultant Dilemma
chapter3_B.description: Your achievements are stunning. Consultant offers pour in. There is a giant offer that demands you violate an old contract due to a time clash.
chapter3_B.dilemma: Accept the dual offer or stay loyal to the contract?

B.feedback: You take a big risk for fast money.

chapter4_A.title: Coup D'État Allegations
chapter4_A.description: Your extensive relations become a boomerang. Political enemies spread rumors that you are mobilizing forces for a coup.
chapter4_A.dilemma: How to respond to this treason accusation?

A.feedback: You fight fire with fire. The situation gets hotter.

B.feedback: You disclose all data. The public sees your honesty.

chapter4_B.title: Coup D'État Allegations (Weak Position)
chapter4_B.description: Because of your previous double-dealing track record, these coup allegations sound very convincing to the public.
chapter4_B.dilemma: How to respond to this treason accusation?

A.feedback: The public is more convinced you are guilty because of your excessive reaction.

B.feedback: A bold step. Suspicion slowly subsides.

chapter5_A.title: The Prince's Death
chapter5_A.description: Prince Litvineko is poisoned to death. You, who were in conflict with him, become the main suspect. The situation is dire.
chapter5_A.dilemma: You are cornered. What must be done?

A.feedback: This cowardly act actually confirms your guilt.

B.feedback: You risk your life on a legal system that may not be fair.

chapter5_B.title: The Prince's Death
chapter5_B.description: Prince Litvineko is poisoned to death. Although your reputation is good, your position as a political rival means the police still investigate you.
chapter5_B.dilemma: You are cornered. What must be done?

A.feedback: All your good reputation is instantly destroyed.

B.feedback: Your composure makes investigators hesitate to name you a suspect.

chapter6_A.title: National Debt Crisis
chapter6_A.description: You escape the murder accusation (somehow). Now the country is bankrupt. Foreign investors pressure you. You have connections to them.
chapter6_A.dilemma: Sell out the country or save the country?

A.feedback: The oligarchy is angry, but the economy starts to stabilize.

B.feedback: You get a huge commission from selling state assets.

chapter6_B.title: National Debt Crisis
chapter6_B.description: Your name is clean. The state asks for your help to lobby foreign investors to overcome the debt crisis.
chapter6_B.dilemma: Sell out the country or save the country?

B.feedback: You mortgage the country's sovereignty for money.

chapter7_A.title: Downfall and Rise
chapter7_A.description: You are slandered as a foreign agent. You are forced to step down. Now you are at ground zero.

A.feedback: You resort to any means necessary. You are back in power, but dirty.

B.feedback: A steep and slow path. But your conscience is clear.

chapter7_B.title: Downfall and Rise
chapter7_B.description: Your previous policies proved detrimental. You are fired. You need power back to protect your assets.

A.feedback: You return to the top, bringing old sins with you.

chapter8_A.title: Subprime Mortgage Project
chapter8_A.description: You are back in power. There is a high-risk investment project (Subprime Mortgage). The commission is 5% upfront.
chapter8_A.dilemma: Take the risk of destroying the economy or play it safe?

A.feedback: You refuse dirty money. Investors are disappointed, the people are safe.

B.feedback: You are rich. The economic time bomb is ready to explode.

chapter8_B.title: Subprime Mortgage Project
chapter8_B.description: Your credibility is restored. Investors offer a complex financial product that is risky but profitable for officials.
chapter8_B.dilemma: Take the risk of destroying the economy or play it safe?

A.feedback: Your integrity saves the country from crisis.

chapter9_A.title: The Father's Scandal
chapter9_A.description: You receive evidence that your Father (the Prime Minister) is the mastermind of the biggest corruption. The people ask you to lead the revolution.

A.feedback: Blood is thicker than water. You and your father are safe, but the country is ruined.

B.feedback: You sacrifice your own father for justice. History records you as a tragic hero.

chapter9_B.title: The Father's Scandal
chapter9_B.description: Amidst the economic chaos you created, it is revealed that your Father is also corrupt. The situation is chaos.

A.feedback: Your political dynasty survives atop the people's suffering.

B.feedback: A final attempt to atone for sins. Your father is imprisoned, you lose everything.
